headline: Committee discharges claims resolution without recommendation, acts on two others

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.voteItem: Motion to reconsider the claims amendment
meeting.summary: Members voted 9-0 to send the claims resolution to the full council without a recommendation and 9-0 to recommend passing the computation of time resolution. Filing was recommended for transfer of appropriations. Most likely on the July 7th agenda.
meeting.recap: A motion was made to advance a charter resolution on who receives claims.[[0:12:25]] That amendment passed on a roll call vote, five ayes to four noes.[[0:17:52]] Members voted nine to zero to reconsider the amendment.[[0:24:29]] The committee voted nine to zero to discharge the claims resolution to the full council without a recommendation.[[0:26:12]] Members looked at a draft resolution on council vacancies with a blank, or puka, for breaking ties.[[0:29:01]] The chair proposed deferring it, and a member objected.[[0:44:33]] The committee voted to recommend filing, or dropping, the resolution on transfer of appropriations.[[1:11:26]] A motion to file the computation of time resolution failed, four ayes to five noes.[[1:15:22]] The committee voted nine to zero to recommend passing that resolution.[[1:16:59]] The resolutions will most likely go to the full council on the July 7th agenda.[[1:19:08]] Staff was asked to draft a letter to the finance department about taking on claims.[[1:20:34]]
decided: The committee voted to reconsider the finance amendment.
The claims resolution was discharged from committee without a recommendation.
The chair proposed deferring the vacancy resolution without objection, a member objected, and the final action is not clear in the recording.
The committee voted to reconsider the transfer of appropriations resolution.
A motion to amend to discharge the transfer of appropriations resolution was withdrawn.
The amendment to recommend filing the transfer of appropriations resolution passed.
The main motion to recommend filing the transfer of appropriations resolution passed.
The amendment to file the computation of time resolution failed on a roll call vote.
The committee recommended passage of the computation of time resolution.
meeting.next: Staff was asked to draft a letter asking finance about obstacles to accepting claims and how long it would take. A member asked that the managing director's office also be consulted on the claims resolution.

moments.q: It's three o'clock and we have to decide by today.
